text:
Sam Liu: FYI, last night the EU warm-pool backfill lagged ~40m, queue depth spiked and we saw some spillover into apac. Grafana panels show pending pods staying >90th percentile. Not an outage but higher per-token cost and degraded batching. @Priya can you triage?

Priya Patel: looking now. linking the dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/abc123/warm-pool-backfill?from=now-6h&to=now — panels: 'pool_pending', 'backfill_rate', 'batch_size_avg'.

Darren Chen: PromQL I used for backfill rate:```sum(rate(warm_pool_fill_attempts_total[5m])) by (pool)```
That was noisy for small pools. Another useful metric: ```increase(queue_pending_requests[10m]) / max(pool_capacity)``` to see proportional backlog.

Marta Novak: I noticed a cluster event spike in eu-west-1 around 03:10 UTC. Lots of evictions and node-terminated messages — looks like spot churn. Query: `kube_event_count{reason="Evicted", region="eu-west-1"}` spiked.

infra-oncall: Confirmed. Autoscaler scaled down nodes at 03:05 then scale-up took ~2m because of spot realloc. Warm pool controllers try to backfill but pods stuck pending due to binpacking. Suggest we avoid aggressive scale-down for warm pools in regions with high spot volatility.

Sam Liu: :thumbsup: don't want global policy changes yet. Proposal: add a short-term override: min_replicas=2 for each warm pool in eu-west-1 for the next 24h, and add a targeted taint-exclusion so backfill pods can land on on-demand nodes. Thoughts?

Priya Patel: +1. Also propose we adjust the alert 'pool_backfill_lag' for eu regions from 10m -> 15m to reduce noise during known spot churn windows, and annotate alert with runbook: https://wiki.redwood/infra/warm-pool-backfill-runbook.

Darren Chen: Quick patch in staging: increased eu alert window and set severity=warning for that rule. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/alerts/pull/432. Will promote after smoke tests.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Prometheus rules apply job started by Darren Chen — status: succeeded.

Marta Novak: Another datapoint: average batch_size for the affected pools dropped from 4.2 -> 1.1 during the spike which explains cost increase and throughput drop. See panel 'avg_batch_size' on the same dashboard.

Sam Liu: Action items: 1) Darren — apply min_replicas override + taint-exclusion (24h); 2) Priya — update alert thresholds/annotations; 3) Darren — promote alert rule change to prod after smoke; 4) Marta — capture batching regression for postmortem if it recurs. I'll quantify cost delta and follow up with product owners.

Priya Patel: Cost estimate: ~+12% token spend for EU customers during the 40m window (prelim). I'll add that to the incident note and tag billing.

Darren Chen: I'll add a new Grafana panel: `backfill_rate / desired_fill_rate` and a small table for pools currently below 50% to make it easier to spot backfill lag without digging through logs.

Sam Liu: Thanks everyone. If nothing else, I'll close this thread in a few hours. Ping here if the override causes any regressions or if the alert promotion fails.
